pages.title: Weapons
pages.text: In AeroIE, a weapon is any offensive component fixed in one direction that cannot rotate freely. Once linked to a Control Seat, weapon channels determine which weapons are active. Press the fire control to fire every active weapon along its mounting direction.$(br2)Non-energy weapons consume ammunition. Their GUIs include ammunition slots that can be filled manually or through any automated logistics system.

pages.title: Fun Fact
pages.text: The first weapon was created by modifying a thruster.
